title: Product development
learning_outcomes: Explain problem framing in the context of product development.
Compare and distinguish prototypes in the context of product development.
Apply user testing in the context of product development.
Evaluate and justify decisions about iteration in the context of product development.

lessons.title: Problem framing
lessons.outcome: Explain problem framing in the context of product development.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving problem framing; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to prototype and test plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain problem framing from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of problem framing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Prototypes
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish prototypes in the context of product development.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving prototypes; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to prototype and test plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain prototypes from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of prototypes; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: User testing
lessons.outcome: Apply user testing in the context of product development.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving user testing; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to prototype and test plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain user testing from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of user testing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Iteration
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about iteration in the context of product development.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving iteration; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to prototype and test plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain iteration from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of iteration; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of problem framing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of prototypes; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of user testing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of iteration; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
